what: M1 hostile and L1: the published probe page (html_render by a Pi Durable agent), framed as t3's web client frames it (sandbox="allow-scripts allow-forms") on the t3 host, in a local Chrome (agent-browser) holding a valid t3 session
control: the same browser's same-origin fetch('/api/auth/session') answered 200
reading: The page runs in an opaque origin (its messages come from origin "null"): document.cookie, localStorage and parent.document throw SecurityError; a credentialed fetch of t3's /api/auth/session and a POST to the harness panel's /_t3flare/harness/api/mcp/servers fail (TypeError: a cross-origin request from an opaque origin, no Lax cookie); a top navigation throws, and the parent stayed on the t3 host. A top-level open of the same capability URL can navigate itself (it is its own top), as on stock.
